scanNote: 92-betdagi 1a-mashqning 'D' rasmi AYNAN SHU BETDA joylashgan (chap yuqorida): gamakda yotib kitob o'qiyotgan ayol — ya'ni 'RELAX' (2-band). 92-betda uni topa olmagan edim; endi tasdiqlandi.

exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

                              6 Greenway Road
                              Wethersham
                              6 May, ...

  Dear Sarah,

  I've got some great news. Richard and I are going
  on holiday for a whole month. Guess where —
  Hawaii!

  We're leaving on 1st June. We both love swimming,
  so we're going to stay at a fabulous hotel right
  next to the beach. I'm going to relax as much as
  possible because I'm quite tired after working
  hard all this year.

  We're coming back from our holidays on 30th June,
  and I've got lots of plans for the rest of the
  summer. First, I'm going to work at a cafe
  because I want to earn some extra money and buy a
  new car. I'm also going to join a gym to lose
  some weight. Finally, I want to find a better job
  in autumn, so I'm going to start a computer
  course.

  Oh, I nearly forgot! On 16th August we're having
  a garden party to celebrate Richard's birthday.
  Please try to come. You're welcome to spend the
  night here.

  Well, that's all for now. Hope to see you soon.

                              Love,
                              Jenny


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

                              6 Grinvey ko'chasi
                              Vetersham
                              6-may, ...

  Hurmatli Sara,

  Menda ajoyib yangilik bor. Richard bilan men
  butun bir oyga ta'tilga ketyapmiz. Qayerga
  ekanini top-chi — Gavayiga!

  Biz 1-iyunda jo'naymiz. Ikkalamiz ham suzishni
  yaxshi ko'ramiz, shuning uchun plyajning
  yonginasidagi ajoyib mehmonxonada turmoqchimiz.
  Men imkon qadar ko'proq dam olmoqchiman, chunki
  butun yil qattiq ishlaganimdan keyin ancha
  charchaganman.

  Biz ta'tildan 30-iyunda qaytamiz va yozning
  qolgan qismiga ko'plab rejalarim bor. Avvalo,
  kafeda ishlamoqchiman, chunki bir oz qo'shimcha
  pul topib, yangi mashina sotib olmoqchiman.
  Shuningdek, biroz vazn tashlash uchun sport
  zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman. Nihoyat, kuzda
  yaxshiroq ish topmoqchiman, shuning uchun
  kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchiman.

  Voy, sal bo'lmasa unutayozdim! 16-avgustda
  Richardning tug'ilgan kunini nishonlash uchun
  bog'da ziyofat qilamiz. Iltimos, kelishga
  harakat qil. Kechasi shu yerda qolsang ham
  mayli.

  Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada ko'rishguncha.

                              Mehr bilan,
                              Jenni


XAT QOLIPI (rasmiy bo'lmagan xat):
  O'ng yuqorida:  MANZIL va SANA
  Boshi:          'Dear Sarah,'
  Oxiri:          'Love, Jenny'
  DIQQAT: 'Love,' — yaqin do'stga yoziladi.


XATDAGI IKKI XIL KELAJAK — ENG MUHIM:

  BE GOING TO  →  REJA va NIYAT
     'we're GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel'
     'I'm GOING TO relax'
     'I'm GOING TO work at a cafe'
     'I'm GOING TO join a gym'
     'I'm GOING TO start a computer course'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS  →  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN reja
     'We're LEAVING on 1st June.'
     'We're COMING BACK ... on 30th June.'
     'On 16th August we're HAVING a garden party.'

  NAQSh: PRESENT CONTINUOUS ishlatilgan uchala
  gapda ham ANIQ SANA bor!
  'be going to' li gaplarda esa sana YO'Q.
  Bu — 93-betdagi grammatika qutisining
  aynan qoidasi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a whole month  = butun bir oy
  Guess where!   = Qayerda ekanini top-chi!
  Hawaii         = Gavayi (AQSh shtati, orollar)
  right next to  = yonginasida
  as much as possible = imkon qadar ko'proq
  extra money    = qo'shimcha pul
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  autumn         = kuz
  I nearly forgot = sal bo'lmasa unutayozdim
  a garden party = bog'dagi ziyofat
  to celebrate   = nishonlamoq
  You're welcome to ... = ... bo'lsangiz mayli
  to spend the night = tunab qolmoq
  that's all for now = hozircha shu

sentences.noteUz:
Rasmiy bo'lmagan xatda MANZIL va SANA
o'ng YUQORIDA yoziladi.
Manzil: uy raqami → ko'cha → shahar.

Xat boshi. Ismdan keyin VERGUL.
Keyingi qator yangi xatboshidan boshlanadi.

sentences.en: I've got some great news. Richard and I are going on holiday for a whole month. Guess where — Hawaii!
sentences.uz: Menda ajoyib yangilik bor. Richard bilan men butun bir oyga ta'tilga ketyapmiz. Qayerga ekanini top-chi — Gavayiga!
sentences.noteUz:
'news' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot ('a news' XATO).
'Richard AND I' — 'I' oxirida turadi.
'go ON holiday' — predlog ON.
'a whole month' = butun bir oy.
4-mashqning 1-bandi shu yerdan: 'GREAT news'.

PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA →
QAT'IY BELGILANGAN reja (chipta olingan).
2-mashqning birinchi sanasi.

sentences.en: We both love swimming, so we're going to stay at a fabulous hotel right next to the beach.
sentences.uz: Ikkalamiz ham suzishni yaxshi ko'ramiz, shuning uchun plyajning yonginasidagi ajoyib mehmonxonada turmoqchimiz.
sentences.noteUz:
'BE GOING TO' — REJA (aniq sana yo'q).
'so' — NATIJA bog'lovchisi.
'love SWIMMING' — 'love' dan keyin '-ing'.
'RIGHT next to' — 'right' kuchaytiradi:
'yonginasida'.
92-betdagi 1-band ✓ va 4-mashqning 3-bandi
('a FABULOUS hotel') shu yerdan.

sentences.en: I'm going to relax as much as possible because I'm quite tired after working hard all this year.
sentences.uz: Men imkon qadar ko'proq dam olmoqchiman, chunki butun yil qattiq ishlaganimdan keyin ancha charchaganman.
sentences.noteUz:
'BE GOING TO' — REJA.
'because' — SABAB.
'as much as possible' = imkon qadar ko'proq.
'after WORKING' — predlogdan keyin '-ing'.
92-betdagi 2-band ✓ (relax) shu yerdan;
4-mashqning 4-bandi ('to WORK hard') ham.

sentences.en: We're coming back from our holidays on 30th June, and I've got lots of plans for the rest of the summer.
sentences.uz: Biz ta'tildan 30-iyunda qaytamiz va yozning qolgan qismiga ko'plab rejalarim bor.
sentences.noteUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA →
QAT'IY BELGILANGAN reja.
2-mashqning ikkinchi sanasi.
'the rest of the summer' = yozning qolgan qismi.

sentences.en: First, I'm going to work at a cafe because I want to earn some extra money and buy a new car.
sentences.uz: Avvalo, kafeda ishlamoqchiman, chunki bir oz qo'shimcha pul topib, yangi mashina sotib olmoqchiman.
sentences.noteUz:
'BE GOING TO' — REJA.
'work AT a cafe' — predlog AT.
'to EARN money' = pul topmoq
('to win money' XATO — u yutuq uchun).
92-betdagi 6-band ✓; 4-mashqning 5-bandi.

sentences.en: I'm also going to join a gym to lose some weight.
sentences.uz: Shuningdek, biroz vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman.
sentences.noteUz:
'BE GOING TO' — REJA.
'TO LOSE' — MAQSAD ('nima uchun?').
'lose weight' = vazn tashlamoq.
92-betdagi 8-band ✓; 4-mashqning 6 va 7-bandlari.

sentences.en: Finally, I want to find a better job in autumn, so I'm going to start a computer course.
sentences.uz: Nihoyat, kuzda yaxshiroq ish topmoqchiman, shuning uchun kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchiman.
sentences.noteUz:
'BE GOING TO' — REJA.
'a BETTER job' — QIYOSIY daraja (Unit 12).
'IN autumn' — fasl bilan predlog IN.
92-betdagi 10-band ✓; 4-mashqning 8-bandi.

sentences.en: Oh, I nearly forgot! On 16th August we're having a garden party to celebrate Richard's birthday.
sentences.uz: Voy, sal bo'lmasa unutayozdim! 16-avgustda Richardning tug'ilgan kunini nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat qilamiz.
sentences.noteUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA →
QAT'IY BELGILANGAN reja.
2-mashqning uchinchi sanasi.
'nearly' = sal bo'lmasa (88-betdagi epizodda ham).
'TO CELEBRATE' — MAQSAD.

sentences.en: Please try to come. You're welcome to spend the night here.
sentences.uz: Iltimos, kelishga harakat qil. Kechasi shu yerda qolsang ham mayli.
sentences.noteUz:
'try TO come' = kelishga harakat qilmoq.
'You're welcome to ...' = ... bo'lsangiz mayli
(taklif qilishning muloyim shakli).
'spend the night' = tunab qolmoq.

sentences.en: Well, that's all for now. Hope to see you soon. Love, Jenny
sentences.uz: Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada ko'rishguncha. Mehr bilan, Jenni.
sentences.noteUz:
Xatning TUGALLANMASI.
'that's all for now' = hozircha shu.
'Hope to see you soon' — 'I' tushirib
qoldirilgan (norasmiy xatda mumkin).
'Love,' — yaqin do'st yoki qarindoshga.

exercises.explanationUz:
92-BETDAGI 1b-MAShQNING TO'LIQ JAVOBI —
XATDAN ANIQLANDI (audio KERAK EMAS).

   1  stay at a fabulous hotel   ✓  (kitob bergan)
   2  relax                      ✓
   3  start windsurfing          ✗
   4  sunbathe                   ✗  (kitob bergan)
   5  take ballet lessons        ✗
   6  work at a cafe             ✓
   7  start French lessons       ✗
   8  join a gym                 ✓
   9  sell her house             ✗
  10  start a computer course    ✓

  ✓ — BESHTA:  1, 2, 6, 8, 10
  ✗ — BESHTA:  3, 4, 5, 7, 9


QOIDA — QANDAY ANIQLANDI:
  Xatda AYTILGAN ish → ✓
  Xatda AYTILMAGAN ish → ✗

  Kitob 4-bandni ('sunbathe') ✗ bilan bergan —
  bu qoidani TASDIQLAYDI: xatda 'sunbathe'
  so'zi umuman yo'q.


HAR BIR ✗ NEGA:
   3  windsurfing — xatda umuman eslatilmagan
      (faqat 'swimming' bor)
   4  sunbathe    — xatda yo'q (kitob bergan)
   5  ballet      — xatda yo'q
   7  French      — xatda yo'q
      (faqat KOMPYUTER kursi bor)
   9  sell her house — xatda yo'q
      (aksincha, u MAShINA SOTIB OLMOQChI)


DIQQAT — 9-BAND ALDAMChI:
  Unit sarlavhasida 'FOR SALE' yozuvli uy rasmi
  bor va 1a-mashqda 'sell her house' bandi bor.
  LEKIN xatda uy sotish haqida BIR SO'Z ham yo'q —
  Jenni MAShINA SOTIB OLMOQChI ('buy a new car').
  Rasm shunchaki mashg'ulotni ko'rsatadi,
  Jennining rejasi emas.


GAPLAR (namunadagidek):

  ✓:
     Jenny is going to stay at a fabulous hotel.
     Jenny is going to relax.
     Jenny is going to work at a cafe.
     Jenny is going to join a gym.
     Jenny is going to start a computer course.

  ✗:
     Jenny isn't going to start windsurfing.
     Jenny isn't going to sunbathe.
     Jenny isn't going to take ballet lessons.
     Jenny isn't going to start French lessons.
     Jenny isn't going to sell her house.

pairs.right: ✓  Jenny is going to stay at a fabulous hotel.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOB BERGAN (✓).
Xatda: 'we're going to stay at a FABULOUS HOTEL
right next to the beach.'

✓ — xatda ANIQ bor:
'I'm going to RELAX as much as possible because
I'm quite tired.'
(92-betdagi 'D' rasmi — gamakda kitob o'qiyotgan
ayol — shu betning chap yuqorisida.)

pairs.right: ✗  Jenny isn't going to start windsurfing.
pairs.whyUz:
✗ — xatda vindserfing UMUMAN eslatilmagan.
Xatda faqat 'we both love SWIMMING' bor —
suzish, vindserfing emas.

KITOB BERGAN (✗).
Xatda 'sunbathe' so'zi UMUMAN yo'q.
Bu — qoidani tasdiqlaydi: xatda aytilmagan
ish ✗ oladi.

pairs.right: ✗  Jenny isn't going to take ballet lessons.
✓  Jenny is going to work at a cafe.
pairs.whyUz:
✓ — xatda ANIQ bor:
'First, I'm going to WORK AT A CAFE because I
want to earn some extra money.'

pairs.right: ✗  Jenny isn't going to start French lessons.
pairs.rightUz: Jenni fransuz tili darslarini boshlamoqchi emas.
pairs.whyUz:
✗ — xatda fransuz tili UMUMAN eslatilmagan.
Xatda faqat KOMPYUTER kursi bor (10-band).

pairs.right: ✓  Jenny is going to join a gym.
pairs.whyUz:
✓ — xatda ANIQ bor:
'I'm also going to JOIN A GYM to lose some
weight.'

pairs.right: ✗  Jenny isn't going to sell her house.
pairs.whyUz:
✗ — ALDAMChI BAND.
Unit sarlavhasida 'FOR SALE' yozuvli uy rasmi
bor, lekin XATDA uy sotish haqida BIR SO'Z ham
yo'q.
Aksincha, Jenni MAShINA SOTIB OLMOQChI:
'buy a new car'.

pairs.right: ✓  Jenny is going to start a computer course.
pairs.whyUz:
✓ — xatda ANIQ bor:
'I'm going to START A COMPUTER COURSE.'
Sababi: 'I want to find a better job in autumn.'

exercises.instructionEn: Answers to Ex. 2 (page 92): what Jenny is doing on 1st June, 30th June and 16th August
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh SANA — HAMMASI XATDAN.

  1st JUNE:
     'We're LEAVING on 1st June.'
     → Jenny is leaving (for Hawaii) on 1st June.
     (Jenni 1-iyunda Gavayiga jo'nab ketadi.)

  30th JUNE:
     'We're COMING BACK from our holidays on 30th
      June.'
     → Jenny is coming back from her holidays on
       30th June.
     (Jenni 30-iyunda ta'tildan qaytadi.)

  16th AUGUST:
     'On 16th August we're HAVING a garden party to
      celebrate Richard's birthday.'
     → Jenny is having a garden party on 16th
       August (to celebrate Richard's birthday).
     (Jenni 16-avgustda Richardning tug'ilgan
      kunini nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat
      qiladi.)


ENG MUHIM KUZATUV:
  Xatda PRESENT CONTINUOUS aynan SHU UChTA gapda
  ishlatilgan — va uchalasida ham ANIQ SANA bor!

  Qolgan hamma rejalar 'BE GOING TO' bilan
  berilgan va ularda SANA YO'Q.

  Bu — 93-betdagi grammatika qutisining qoidasi:
     'be going to'        →  reja va niyat
     'present continuous' →  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN
                             reja (fixed arrangement)


NEGA BU FARQ MUHIM:
  Chipta olingan, joy band qilingan, sana
  belgilangan → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
  Faqat niyat qilingan, hali aniq emas →
  BE GOING TO.

  Jennining ta'tili ANIQ (chipta bor) → 'we're
  leaving'.
  Kafedagi ish esa hali REJA → 'I'm going to
  work'.

points.en: 1st June — Jenny is leaving (for Hawaii).
points.uz: 1-iyun — Jenni (Gavayiga) jo'nab ketadi.
points.noteUz:
Xatda: 'We're LEAVING on 1st June.'
PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA.

points.en: 30th June — Jenny is coming back from her holidays.
points.uz: 30-iyun — Jenni ta'tildan qaytadi.
points.noteUz:
Xatda: 'We're COMING BACK from our holidays on
30th June.'
'come back FROM' — predlog FROM.

points.en: 16th August — Jenny is having a garden party to celebrate Richard's birthday.
points.uz: 16-avgust — Jenni Richardning tug'ilgan kunini nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat qiladi.
points.noteUz:
Xatda: 'On 16th August we're HAVING a garden
party TO CELEBRATE Richard's birthday.'
'to celebrate' — MAQSAD.

points.en: All three use the present continuous — and all three have a fixed date.
points.uz: Uchalasida ham present continuous ishlatilgan — va uchalasida ham aniq sana bor.
points.noteUz:
Xatdagi qolgan rejalar 'be going to' bilan
berilgan va ularda SANA YO'Q.
Bu — grammatika qutisining aynan qoidasi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read Jenny's letter and answer the questions. (answers)
exercises.instructionUz: Jennining xatini o'qing va savollarga javob bering. (javoblar)

points.en: 1  Where is Jenny going to spend her summer holiday?
points.uz: 1  Jenni yozgi ta'tilini qayerda o'tkazmoqchi?
points.noteUz: SAVOL.

points.en: She is going to spend it in Hawaii. She and Richard are going to stay at a fabulous hotel right next to the beach.
points.uz: U ta'tilini Gavayida o'tkazmoqchi. U Richard bilan plyajning yonginasidagi ajoyib mehmonxonada turmoqchi.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
Xatda: 'Guess where — HAWAII!' va
'we're going to stay at a FABULOUS HOTEL right
next to the beach.'
Gavayi — Tinch okeandagi AQSh shtati.

points.en: 2  What is Jenny going to do during her holiday?
points.uz: 2  Jenni ta'til davomida nima qilmoqchi?
points.noteUz: SAVOL.

points.en: She is going to relax as much as possible, because she is quite tired after working hard all this year. She and Richard both love swimming.
points.uz: U imkon qadar ko'proq dam olmoqchi, chunki butun yil qattiq ishlaganidan keyin ancha charchagan. U va Richard ikkalasi ham suzishni yaxshi ko'radi.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
TA'TIL davridagi rejalar: 1-band (mehmonxona)
va 2-band (relax).
'because' bilan SABAB ko'rsatilgan.

points.en: 3  What are Jenny's plans for the rest of the summer?
points.uz: 3  Jennining yozning qolgan qismiga rejalari qanday?
points.noteUz:
SAVOL.
Ta'tildan KEYINGI rejalar.

points.en: She is going to work at a cafe to earn some extra money and buy a new car. She is also going to join a gym to lose some weight. Finally, she is going to start a computer course because she wants to find a better job in autumn.
points.uz: U qo'shimcha pul topib, yangi mashina sotib olish uchun kafeda ishlamoqchi. Shuningdek, biroz vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi. Nihoyat, kuzda yaxshiroq ish topmoqchi bo'lgani uchun kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchi.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
UCH reja: 6, 8, 10-bandlar.
Xatda 'First ... also ... Finally ...' bilan
tartiblangan.

points.en: 4  When is Jenny having a party? Why?
points.uz: 4  Jenni qachon ziyofat qiladi? Nega?
points.noteUz:
SAVOL.
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — aniq sanaga belgilangan.

points.en: She is having a garden party on 16th August to celebrate Richard's birthday.
points.uz: U 16-avgustda Richardning tug'ilgan kunini nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat qiladi.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
'When?' → 16th August.
'Why?' → to celebrate Richard's birthday.
MAQSAD 'to + fe'l' bilan berilgan.

sections.title: Speaking — Jenny's plans and arrangements
sections.titleUz: Gapirish — Jennining rejalari va belgilangan ishlari

exercises.instructionEn: Copy and complete the tables, then talk about Jenny's plans/intentions and arrangements. Use because or to-inf to join the sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvallarni ko'chirib to'ldiring, so'ng Jennining rejalari/niyatlari va belgilangan ishlari haqida gapiring. Gaplarni birlashtirish uchun 'because' yoki 'to + fe'l' dan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI JADVAL:

─────────────────────────────────────────────────
 JADVAL 1 — PLANS/INTENTIONS + REASON/PURPOSE
            (rejalar/niyatlar + sabab/maqsad)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  they/stay at ...  A HOTEL
     they both love ...  SWIMMING       (namuna)

  she/relax ...  AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE
     she's quite ...  TIRED (after working hard
                            all this year)

  she/work ...  AT A CAFE
     earn ...  SOME EXTRA MONEY (and buy a new car)

  she/join ...  A GYM
     lose ...  SOME WEIGHT

  she/start ...  A COMPUTER COURSE
     find ...  A BETTER JOB (in autumn)


─────────────────────────────────────────────────
 JADVAL 2 — FIXED ARRANGEMENTS
            (qat'iy belgilangan ishlar)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  they/leave on ...  1ST JUNE

  they/come back ...  FROM THEIR HOLIDAYS
     on ...  30TH JUNE

  they/have a ...  GARDEN PARTY
     on ...  16TH AUGUST
     to ...  CELEBRATE RICHARD'S BIRTHDAY


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'They ARE GOING TO stay at a hotel next to the
   beach BECAUSE they both love swimming.'


IKKI XIL BOG'LOVChI — QAChON QAYSI BIRI:

  BECAUSE  →  SABAB (nega?)
     'because they both love swimming'
     'because she's quite tired'
     Ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bo'ladi.

  TO + fe'l  →  MAQSAD (nima uchun?)
     'to earn some extra money'
     'to lose some weight'
     'to find a better job'
     Ergash gapda ega YO'Q.


DIQQAT — JADVALDAGI IP:
  Jadvalning o'ng ustunida FE'L berilgan bo'lsa
  ('earn', 'lose', 'find') → 'TO + fe'l' ishlating.
  Sifat yoki gap berilgan bo'lsa
  ('they both love ...', 'she's quite ...') →
  'BECAUSE' ishlating.


BARCHA GAPLAR — PLANS/INTENTIONS (be going to):

  1  They are going to stay at a hotel next to the
     beach BECAUSE they both love swimming.
                                        (NAMUNA)

  2  She is going to relax as much as possible
     BECAUSE she's quite tired.

  3  She is going to work at a cafe TO EARN some
     extra money.

  4  She is going to join a gym TO LOSE some
     weight.

  5  She is going to start a computer course TO
     FIND a better job.


BARCHA GAPLAR — FIXED ARRANGEMENTS
(present continuous):

  6  They are leaving on 1st June.

  7  They are coming back from their holidays on
     30th June.

  8  They are having a garden party on 16th August
     TO CELEBRATE Richard's birthday.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Ular plyaj yonidagi mehmonxonada turmoqchi,
     chunki ikkalasi ham suzishni yaxshi ko'radi.
  2  U imkon qadar ko'proq dam olmoqchi, chunki
     ancha charchagan.
  3  U qo'shimcha pul topish uchun kafeda
     ishlamoqchi.
  4  U vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga a'zo
     bo'lmoqchi.
  5  U yaxshiroq ish topish uchun kompyuter
     kursini boshlamoqchi.
  6  Ular 1-iyunda jo'naydilar.
  7  Ular 30-iyunda ta'tildan qaytadilar.
  8  Ular 16-avgustda Richardning tug'ilgan kunini
     nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat qiladilar.


ENG MUHIM — IKKI JADVAL IKKI GRAMMATIKA:
  1-jadval (PLANS/INTENTIONS) → BE GOING TO
  2-jadval (FIXED ARRANGEMENTS) → PRESENT
                                   CONTINUOUS
  Bu — 93-betdagi grammatika qutisining
  amaliy mashqi.

exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan so'zlarni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  computer, great, go, earn, work, join, lose,
  fabulous

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  GREAT news          (ajoyib yangilik)
  2  to GO on holiday    (ta'tilga bormoq)
  3  a FABULOUS hotel    (ajoyib mehmonxona)
  4  to WORK hard        (qattiq ishlamoq)
  5  to EARN money       (pul topmoq)
  6  to JOIN a gym       (sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoq)
  7  to LOSE weight      (vazn tashlamoq)
  8  a COMPUTER course   (kompyuter kursi)


HAMMASI JENNINING XATIDAN:
  1  'I've got some GREAT NEWS.'
  2  'we are GOING ON HOLIDAY for a whole month'
  3  'a FABULOUS HOTEL right next to the beach'
  4  'after WORKING HARD all this year'
  5  'I want to EARN some extra MONEY'
  6  'I'm also going to JOIN A GYM'
  7  'to LOSE some WEIGHT'
  8  'I'm going to start a COMPUTER COURSE'


QANDAY ANIQLASh — SO'Z TURIGA QARANG:

  'TO' bor (2, 4, 5, 6, 7) → FE'L kerak:
     go, work, earn, join, lose

  'A' bor (3, 8) → OT yoki SIFAT kerak:
     a FABULOUS hotel (sifat)
     a COMPUTER course (ot, sifat vazifasida)

  Artiklsiz (1) → SIFAT:
     GREAT news
     ('news' SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' YO'Q)


ENG MUHIM BIRIKMALAR — YODLASh KERAK:

  to EARN money   =  pul topmoq (mehnat bilan)
     DIQQAT: 'to WIN money' — yutuqda, sovrinda.
             'to earn' — ishlab topish.

  to LOSE weight  =  vazn tashlamoq
     Aksi: 'to PUT ON weight' (vazn olmoq).
     DIQQAT: 'to lose' — yo'qotmoq.

  to JOIN a gym   =  sport zaliga A'ZO BO'LMOQ
     DIQQAT: 'to go to a gym' — shunchaki bormoq.

  to WORK hard    =  qattiq ishlamoq
     DIQQAT: 'hardly' — BUTUNLAY boshqa so'z
     ('deyarli emas')! 'work hardly' XATO.

  to GO on holiday =  ta'tilga bormoq
     Predlog ON.


DIQQAT — 1 va 3-BANDLAR IKKALASI HAM 'AJOYIB':
     GREAT news      — 'great' = ajoyib, zo'r
     FABULOUS hotel  — 'fabulous' = ajoyib, zo'r
  Ma'nolari yaqin, lekin kitob har birini AYNAN
  xatdagi joyida ishlatishni so'raydi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'GREAT news' = ajoyib yangilik.
Xatning birinchi jumlasi:
'I've got some GREAT NEWS.'
DIQQAT: 'news' SANALMAYDIGAN ot → 'a' YO'Q.

'to GO ON holiday' = ta'tilga bormoq.
'TO' bor → FE'L kerak.
Xatda: 'we are GOING ON HOLIDAY for a whole
month'.
Predlog ON.

'a FABULOUS hotel' = ajoyib mehmonxona.
'A' va ot orasida → SIFAT kerak.
Xatda: 'a FABULOUS HOTEL right next to the
beach'.
92-betdagi 1-band ham shu.

'to WORK HARD' = qattiq ishlamoq.
Xatda: 'after WORKING HARD all this year'.
DIQQAT: 'hard' (qattiq) va 'hardly'
(deyarli emas) — BUTUNLAY boshqa so'zlar!
'work hardly' XATO.

'to EARN money' = pul topmoq (mehnat bilan).
Xatda: 'I want to EARN some extra MONEY'.
DIQQAT: 'to WIN money' — yutuq, sovrin uchun.
'to earn' — ishlab topish.

'to JOIN a gym' = sport zaliga A'ZO BO'LMOQ.
Xatda: 'I'm also going to JOIN A GYM'.
DIQQAT: 'to go to a gym' — shunchaki bormoq;
'to join' — a'zolik ochish.

'to LOSE weight' = vazn tashlamoq.
Xatda: 'to LOSE some WEIGHT'.
Aksi: 'to PUT ON weight' (vazn olmoq).
lose → LOST (noto'g'ri fe'l).

'a COMPUTER course' = kompyuter kursi.
Xatda: 'I'm going to start a COMPUTER COURSE'.
DIQQAT: 'computer' — OT, lekin bu yerda SIFAT
vazifasini bajaradi (ot + ot birikmasi).
Birinchi ot KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI
('computers course' XATO).

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — 'BE GOING TO' NING TO'RT
ShAKLI:

 ┌───────────────┬──────────────────────────────┐
 │ AFFIRMATIVE   │ I AM / You ARE / He IS, etc  │
 │ (tasdiq)      │ GOING TO move house.         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ NEGATIVE      │ I'M NOT / You AREN'T /       │
 │ (inkor)       │ He ISN'T, etc                │
 │               │ GOING TO move house.         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ INTERROGATIVE │ AM I / ARE you / IS he, etc  │
 │ (so'roq)      │ GOING TO move house?         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ SHORT ANSWERS │ Yes, I AM / you ARE /        │
 │ (qisqa javob) │      he IS, etc.             │
 │               │ No, I'M NOT / you AREN'T /   │
 │               │     he ISN'T, etc.           │
 └───────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘


ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  'be going to' da O'ZGARADIGAN QISM faqat
  'BE' fe'li (am / is / are).
  'going to' HECh QAChON o'zgarmaydi.

  TASDIQ:  ega + AM/IS/ARE + going to + fe'l
  INKOR:   ega + AM/IS/ARE + NOT + going to + fe'l
  SO'ROQ:  AM/IS/ARE + ega + going to + fe'l?


DIQQAT — INKORDA 'NOT' QAYERDA:
  'be' fe'lidan KEYIN:
     I AM NOT going to ...   → I'M NOT going to ...
     You ARE NOT going to ... → You AREN'T going to ...
     He IS NOT going to ...  → He ISN'T going to ...

  'I don't going to' XATO —
  'do/does' KERAK EMAS.


DIQQAT — SO'ROQDA 'BE' OLDINGA ChIQADI:
     'Are you going to move house?'  ✓
     'Do you going to move house?'   ✗


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBDA 'GOING TO' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'Are you going to move house?'
     'Yes, I AM.'          ✓
     'Yes, I am going to.' — to'liq, lekin qisqa
                             javob emas


'MOVE HOUSE' NIMA:
  'to move house' = boshqa uyga ko'chib o'tmoq.
  DIQQAT: 'house' oldidan artikl YO'Q —
  bu turg'un ibora.

points.en: Affirmative: I am / You are / He is, etc going to move house.
points.uz: Tasdiq: I am / You are / He is ... going to move house.
points.noteUz:
ega + AM/IS/ARE + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
'going to' O'ZGARMAYDI.

points.en: Negative: I'm not / You aren't / He isn't, etc going to move house.
points.uz: Inkor: I'm not / You aren't / He isn't ... going to move house.
points.noteUz:
'NOT' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN qo'yiladi.
'I don't going to' XATO — 'do' KERAK EMAS.

points.en: Interrogative: Am I / Are you / Is he, etc going to move house?
points.uz: So'roq: Am I / Are you / Is he ... going to move house?
points.noteUz:
'BE' fe'li OLDINGA chiqadi.
'Do you going to ...?' XATO.

points.en: Short answers: Yes, I am / you are / he is, etc. No, I'm not / you aren't / he isn't, etc.
points.uz: Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am / you are / he is ... No, I'm not / you aren't / he isn't ...
points.noteUz:
Qisqa javobda 'going to' TAKRORLANMAYDI —
faqat 'be' fe'li qoladi.

points.en: to move house
points.uz: boshqa uyga ko'chib o'tmoq
points.noteUz:
Turg'un ibora — 'house' oldidan ARTIKL YO'Q.
'to move a house' XATO.

exercises.instructionUz: be going to va present continuous
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKINChI QUTI:

  'We use BE GOING TO to talk about FUTURE PLANS
   AND INTENTIONS. We use the PRESENT CONTINUOUS
   to talk about FIXED FUTURE ARRANGEMENTS.'

  = 'be going to' ni KELAJAK REJALARI va
    NIYATLARI haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.
    'present continuous' ni esa QAT'IY
    BELGILANGAN kelajak ishlari haqida gapirish
    uchun ishlatamiz.


KITOBDAGI IKKI RASM VA GAP:

  CHAP RASM — plans/intentions (BE GOING TO)
     Yigit qizga gapiryapti:
     'I'M GOING TO fly to Poland SOON.'
     (Yaqinda Polshaga uchmoqchiman.)
     → 'soon' = yaqinda — ANIQ vaqt YO'Q.
       Hali chipta olinmagan, faqat NIYAT.

  O'NG RASM — fixed arrangements
               (PRESENT CONTINUOUS)
     Yigit qo'lida ChIPTA ushlab turibdi:
     'I'M FLYING to Poland AT 7 O'CLOCK.'
     (Soat yettida Polshaga uchaman.)
     → 'at 7 o'clock' = ANIQ vaqt.
       Chipta olingan, hamma narsa TAYYOR.

  DIQQAT: rasmda yigitning qo'lida ChIPTA bor —
  kitob shu bilan farqni KO'RSATMOQDA.


ENG SODDA QOIDA:

     ANIQ VAQT (sana, soat) bormi?
        HA   →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS
        YO'Q →  BE GOING TO


JENNINING XATIDA BU QOIDA ANIQ IShLAGAN:

  BE GOING TO (sana YO'Q):
     'we're GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel'
     'I'm GOING TO relax'
     'I'm GOING TO work at a cafe'
     'I'm GOING TO join a gym'
     'I'm GOING TO start a computer course'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (sana BOR):
     'We're LEAVING ON 1ST JUNE.'
     'We're COMING BACK ... ON 30TH JUNE.'
     'ON 16TH AUGUST we're HAVING a garden party.'

  BEShTA 'be going to' — hech qaysisida sana yo'q.
  UChTA 'present continuous' — uchalasida ham
  sana bor.
  BITTA ISTISNO ham yo'q.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  'I'm going to visit my grandmother.'
     (Buvimnikiga bormoqchiman — qachonligi
      hali aniq emas.)

  'I'm visiting my grandmother on Sunday.'
     (Yakshanba kuni buvimnikiga boraman —
      kelishilgan.)

  'We're going to move house.'
     (Ko'chib o'tmoqchimiz — reja.)

  'We're moving house next Friday.'
     (Keyingi juma ko'chib o'tamiz — sana
      belgilangan.)

points.en: We use the present continuous to talk about fixed future arrangements.
points.uz: 'present continuous' ni qat'iy belgilangan kelajak ishlari haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
ANIQ VAQT BOR — chipta olingan, joy band
qilingan, sana kelishilgan.

points.en: plans/intentions — be going to: I'm going to fly to Poland soon.
points.uz: rejalar/niyatlar — be going to: Yaqinda Polshaga uchmoqchiman.
points.noteUz:
'SOON' = yaqinda — ANIQ vaqt EMAS.
Chap rasmda yigitning qo'lida hech narsa yo'q.

exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (9 ta mashg'ulot):
  stay at home            (uyda qolmoq)
  watch TV                (televizor ko'rmoq)
  meet my friends         (do'stlarim bilan
                           uchrashmoq)
  have a party            (ziyofat qilmoq)
  play football           (futbol o'ynamoq)
  study for a test        (imtihonga tayyorlanmoq)
  fly to New Delhi        (Nyu-Delhiga uchmoq)
  listen to music and relax (musiqa tinglab dam
                             olmoq)
  clean my room           (xonamni yig'ishtirmoq)


KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:
  ✓ 'I'M GOING TO listen to music and relax.'
  ✗ 'I'M NOT GOING TO fly to New Delhi.'


TOPShIRIQ:
  UChTA ✓ gap  +  UChTA ✗ gap = jami OLTITA


QOLIP:
  ✓  I'M GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
  ✗  I'M NOT GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.

  DIQQAT: 'I' bilan DOIM 'AM' →
  'I'm going to' / 'I'm not going to'.


NAMUNA JAVOB (oltita gap):

  QILMOQChIMAN (✓):
     I'm going to listen to music and relax.
                                        (NAMUNA)
     I'm going to meet my friends.
     I'm going to study for a test.

  QILMOQChI EMASMAN (✗):
     I'm not going to fly to New Delhi.  (NAMUNA)
     I'm not going to have a party.
     I'm not going to clean my room.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Musiqa tinglab dam olmoqchiman.
  Do'stlarim bilan uchrashmoqchiman.
  Imtihonga tayyorlanmoqchiman.
  Nyu-Delhiga uchmoqchi emasman.
  Ziyofat qilmoqchi emasman.
  Xonamni yig'ishtirmoqchi emasman.


DIQQAT — 'FLY TO NEW DELHI' NEGA NAMUNADA ✗:
  Bu — ro'yxatdagi eng EHTIMOLSIZ ish.
  Kitob uni ataylab ✗ namunasi qilib olgan.


DIQQAT — FE'L BIRIKMALARI:
  'STAY AT home'      — predlog AT, artikl YO'Q
  'WATCH TV'          — 'TV' oldidan artikl YO'Q
  'MEET my friends'   — predlogsiz
  'HAVE a party'      — 'make a party' XATO
  'PLAY football'     — sport oldidan artikl YO'Q
  'STUDY FOR a test'  — predlog FOR
  'FLY TO' + shahar   — predlog TO
  'LISTEN TO music'   — predlog TO
  'CLEAN my room'     — predlogsiz


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a test      = imtihon, nazorat ishi
  to study for = ... ga tayyorlanmoq
  New Delhi   = Nyu-Delhi (Hindiston poytaxti)
  to clean    = tozalamoq, yig'ishtirmoq
